qa.note: A mothballed status needs a dated source. None was found for units 5 and 6. The 2020 retirement of coal unit 4 is documented, but that is a different unit. A search found no 2021 or later article on mothballing the gas units.
I did not find a PJM deactivation notice, and Marion is in the grid operator MISO, not PJM. No planned retirement is proposed. The 2021 Illinois law deadline is not a retirement date.
